name: Feature-first
description: Harness architecture pattern that groups code by product/domain feature and keeps feature internals isolated behind explicit public boundaries.

rules.title: Group feature-owned code together
rules.summary: Prefer feature/domain ownership over a growing set of global technical buckets once the project is large enough to benefit from explicit feature boundaries.

rules.title: Do not import another feature's internals directly
rules.summary: Cross-feature dependencies should use an explicit public interface rather than reaching into another feature's internal files.

rules.title: Keep shared code ownership-neutral
rules.summary: Shared modules should contain genuinely reusable ownership-neutral code rather than feature-specific logic moved out to bypass boundaries.

sources.title: Agentic Harness feature-first architecture pattern
sources.notes: Harness-owned pattern. Framework-specific profiles may strengthen, weaken or supersede its recommendations where official guidance differs.
